root_cause: The current canary uses a full-frame generative image edit for a task whose contract requires source preservation.
Prompt-only preservation is insufficient: the provider removed existing source badges/text despite explicit instructions to preserve them.
The previous workflow had no deterministic protected-region guard capable of rejecting unauthorized text/badge removal before promotion.
required_before_any_paid_retry: Introduce a protected-region strategy so non-authorized source text/badges are pixel-preserved or otherwise deterministically locked.
Separate PRESERVE / deterministic cleanup from true generative edit actions; do not send already-acceptable source images through a full-frame generative redraw merely for cosmetic cleanup.
Add deterministic post-generation QA that compares protected regions and rejects unauthorized removal/change.
Keep exact Source Truth product/variant identity and source SHA binding.
Keep max_products=1, max_variants=1, max_paid_requests=1 for any future retry unless Owner explicitly expands scope.
Obtain a new explicit Owner authorization before any second paid request.
